change_source/learned:
On 21 December 2023 the Security Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2719 on financing African Union-led peace support operations. It agreed to consider requests case by case. For authorized operations, UN assessed contributions could cover up to 75 percent of the annual budget, with the United Nations and African Union jointly mobilizing the remainder as extrabudgetary resources. The Council committed to consider options if significant shortfalls arose.

The Council voted on US amendment S/2023/1023 at S/PV.9518, adopting it by nine votes in favour, none against, and six abstentions (including France). The amended draft S/2023/999 subsequently passed unanimously with 15 votes in favour. France abstained, citing insufficient clarity on financing the 25 percent outside assessed contributions, though it reaffirmed support for assessed UN financing for AU-led operations.
